name: contact-01
title: Contact 01 - A Form The Caller Declares, Beside The Address
description: A contact section whose fields the caller declares, drawn beside an optional address block with a real mailto link that carries the caller's own accessible name. The declared field list is the whole design: a contact form with a fixed set of fields decides what a reader may say, and one that cannot ask for an order number, a company size or a budget loses the message it was given. The submit handler is required and the Block sends nothing, and no success message is rendered. Every string is passed in as a prop.
